// diagnostic

L1401

compiler-extension `{rule}` ({severity}): {message}

What

compiler-extension `{rule}` ({severity}): {message}

Why

A configured compiler-extension component (`JET_COMPILER_EXTENSION`) reported this finding after type checking (D-DX5-HOOK1). V1 surfaces findings as lints; wall with `policy.lints.deny`.

Fix

Address the finding, or unset `JET_COMPILER_EXTENSION` to skip the extension.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L1401: tests/ui_lint/compiler_extension_finding.warn.

Warning [L0104] (unused_private_fn): private function `x` is never called or used as a value.
  --> tests/ui_lint/compiler_extension_finding.jet:3:4
    |
  3 | fn x() {}
    |    ^
 Why: A private function with no reachable reference is dead code; public functions stay exempt because other modules may use them.
 Fix: remove the function, or rename `x` to `_x` when it is intentional.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0104
